auth.terms.p1: DXRating is a community rating and song-information service provided by MikuNet LLC. These terms apply to its website and apps. Read them before creating an account or signing in. If you do not agree, do not create an account or sign in.
auth.terms.p2: Keep your account credentials secure and use the service lawfully. Do not impersonate others, access accounts without permission, interfere with the service, or submit spam.
auth.terms.p3: Objectionable content and abusive behavior are not allowed. Do not post harassment, threats, hate speech, sexually explicit content, exploitation of children, illegal material, private information without consent, or content that infringes another person’s rights.
auth.terms.p4: You retain ownership of your contributions. You give DXRating permission to store, display, and process them as needed to operate and moderate the service. Only submit content you have the right to share. Public contributions may be visible to other users.
auth.terms.p5: Use a comment’s menu to report inappropriate content or block its author. Reports are sent to our moderation inbox; blocking hides that author’s comments for you. We review reports and may remove content, restrict access, or suspend abusive accounts. For support or moderation concerns, contact us through the community support link below.
auth.terms.p6: You may stop using DXRating and delete your account in account settings. Our Privacy Policy explains how personal information is handled. Records stored only on your device must be managed separately; keep backups of data you want to retain.
auth.terms.p7: DXRating is provided as available. We do not guarantee uninterrupted service or the accuracy of song data, ratings, or community content. Nothing in these terms limits rights or liabilities that cannot be limited under applicable law. We may update these terms and will present material changes before asking you to agree again.

rating-calculator.io.import.net-records.dialog.help.regist: I don't have a SEGA ID yet
Create a SEGA ID on SEGA's official registration page.
Sign in to maimai NET with that SEGA ID, then register the Aime card you use to play.
Return here and enter the same SEGA ID and password.
My Aime card is linked through another sign-in method
If you use OAuth or another non-SEGA ID sign-in, move the card to a SEGA ID account before importing.
Open the account where your Aime card is currently bound.
Disconnect the card binding from that account.
Create a SEGA ID, sign in with it, and register the same Aime card before importing.
